reviewer: Implementation agent; advisory and source curation after scanner implementation froze at 68bdf83. No independent unseen-source review is claimed.
condition: The registered fetch_html tool must reject a caller-supplied HTTP URL whose parsed IPv4 hostname is 127.0.0.1 before its initial outbound fetch
prerequisites: Use the upstream stdio SDK server, registered fetch_html and RequestPayloadSchema with url=http://127.0.0.1/ and ordinary defaults; no custom service or transport overrides.

The condition scores initial IPv4-loopback destination rejection before fetch. Redirects, DNS names/rebinding, IPv6, proxies, remote availability, response parsing and successful exfiltration are outside this label.
Dependency semantics are source-reviewed private-ip 3.0.2, as declared and pinned in the retained package/lock files. No dependency installation or target execution is part of this proposal.
flow: CallToolRequestSchema -> RequestPayloadSchema.parse -> Fetcher.html -> this._fetch -> private-IP rejection branch -> native fetch of the same caller URL. The original predicate receives a URL string; the upstream fix passes URL.hostname. Exact IPv4-loopback and public-literal labels are supported by the retained dependency source, not inferred from helper names.
fixed_scope: Initial IPv4 literal only. Later upstream SSRF fixes exist; this commit is not a claim of complete SSRF protection or a patched package release.
